title: Getting along with his brothers
summary: No rivalry; he brought John and Joe into jazz and their father made sure there were no grudges.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Wow. Was there any rivalry with your brothers regarding music?

No. We’ve always gotten along. We never had any kind of arguments that I can see. Basically I was the first one interested in jazz. I got interested in it, I roped my brother John and Joe into it, I got them into it, and then some local kids that were in school with us, I got one of them to play bass and a couple of them played trumpet. But we never really fought over anything. Even to this day we’re still in kind of an agreement. And it’s kind of unusual. You know I played a club here called The Rex and I know the club owner Bob is always amazed that the three brothers get along you know. But we’ve always gotten along.
It was instilled, my father did that to us, just to make sure that none of us — I mean there was always little spats occasionally but never any grudges.
